en: A black‑and‑white panoramic view of a European riverside town. In the foreground there is a river with embankments; behind it stand early 20th‑century apartment buildings and streets. Dominating the middle ground is a tall church with a slender Gothic spire and clock. In the far background on a hill stands a large cathedral-like complex with twin towers, along with other civic and residential buildings. The handwritten caption in the upper left reads "Meißen–R."
